admission.justification: The member obligations together keep execution prose out, failures actionable and reports reachable by exact request identity. Whole-control wrapping may change row height with available space or control count, but reply length cannot change it.

guarantee: The role launcher remains a controls-only strip whose height does not follow reply length; controls wrap whole when they cannot fit, with no execution prose: it starts exactly its admitted canonical selection, shows the shared preparation truth and keeps failures in one actionable line; Result preserves the selected execution’s exact request identity and opens its report in the existing reader. Ordinary singleton and Projects rows retain their open-request second-start prohibition; selected sprint/master Investigator rows admit separate requests under the shared capacity owner and retain each selected UUID through recovery and remount.
title: The launcher strip carries no execution prose and keeps the report one action away
